frequency_question: How often do structural frictions or institutional blockages prevent a central bank from implementing an announced or contemplated liquidity restriction tool within a short window?
membership_rule: Includes major emerging market central bank announcements of secondary reserve requirements or incremental reserve ratios; excludes routine primary reserve ratio adjustments.

cases.name: Central Bank of Brazil compulsory deposit requirement adjustment
Bank Indonesia secondary reserve requirement shift

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 5 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 5 named major emerging market instances; population of similar specific secondary reserve ratio implementations is small but perfectly executed once decided.
known_gaps: Excludes minor unannounced administrative adjustments or shelved proposals that did not reach official circular stage.
skeleton: Central bank policy tool deployments under administrative friction across emerging markets, sampled over major tightening cycles.
multiplier: 5 hits / 5 attempts in major observed instances of secondary liquidity tool deployment.
validity_reason: Central bank operational autonomy and institutional mechanisms for issuing reserve ratio mandates remain stable over multi-year horizons.
